```yaml
name: Publish Binaries to GitHub Releases

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  build-and-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2
        with:
          deno-version: '1.30.0'  # Use the version you need

      - name: Compile binaries for x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
        run: deno compile --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc ./src/main.ts -o bin/invidious-companion-win.exe

      - name: Compile binaries for x86_64-apple-darwin
        run: deno compile --target x86_64-apple-darwin ./src/main.ts -o bin/invidious-companion-macos

      - name: Compile binaries for aarch64-apple-darwin
        run: deno compile --target aarch64-apple-darwin ./src/main.ts -o bin/invidious-companion-macos-arm64

      - name: Compile binaries for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
        run: deno compile --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu ./src/main.ts -o bin/invidious-companion-linux

      - name: Compile binaries for aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
        run: deno compile --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu ./src/main.ts -o bin/invidious-companion-linux-arm64

      - name: Create release assets directory
        run: mkdir -p release-assets

      - name: Move compiled binaries to release assets directory
        run: mv bin/* release-assets/

      - name: Upload release assets
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: release-assets/*
          asset_name: invidious-companion-binaries.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip
```
